plan_validity.physical_quantity: boolean acceptance of the plan by exact WNTR/EPANET simulation plus prescreen
plan_validity.invalid_plan_handling: n/a -- this IS the validity signal
plan_validity.relationship_to_ranking: gates which candidates enter the plan_value/proxy pool at all

exposure_proxy.physical_quantity: ratio of this plan's contaminant mass consumed to the no-action baseline's own
exposure_proxy.normalization: ratio to no-response baseline (per-incident, not per-pool)
exposure_proxy.clipping: none (can exceed 1.0 if a plan is worse than doing nothing)
exposure_proxy.masking: masked when candidate invalid, or consequences/no_response/valid_pool unavailable
exposure_proxy.invalid_plan_handling: target fully masked (0.0 placeholder, mask=False), never imputed
exposure_proxy.reference_baseline_plan: NO_ACTION plan's own exact WNTR consequences, this SAME incident
exposure_proxy.relationship_to_ranking: one of 4 additive components of cost -> regret -> plan_value
exposure_proxy.per_plan_or_per_incident: per-plan (numerator), but scaled by a per-incident constant (denominator)

pressure_risk_proxy.physical_quantity: total simulated minutes any node's pressure fell below minimum_pressure_m (10.0m default)
pressure_risk_proxy.STRUCTURAL_DEGENERACY_FINDING: MATHEMATICALLY GUARANTEED ZERO for every VALID candidate: PlanVerifier.verify() rejects (PlanDecision.REJECTED, hence plan_validity=False, hence this target is MASKED not merely zero) whenever minimum_pressure_m < the SAME minimum_pressure_m threshold used to compute pressure_violation_minutes itself (src/hydroswarm/simulation/wrapper.py:1341/1349 for the hydraulic-only path, 1477 for the exposure-aware path actually used by strategist label generation). pressure_violation_minutes > 0 at any timestep implies minimum_pressure < threshold at that timestep, which implies the simulation-wide minimum_pressure_m also falls below threshold, which implies PRESSURE_BELOW_MINIMUM fires and the plan is REJECTED. Therefore pressure_risk_proxy == 0.0 for EVERY plan whose plan_validity target is True, by construction of the safety gate -- not a bug, not a population artifact, not fixable without weakening the safety threshold (forbidden).

service_loss_proxy.physical_quantity: fraction of REQUESTED demand not delivered, aggregated over the simulation window
service_loss_proxy.STRUCTURAL_BOUND_FINDING: BOUNDED (not mathematically forced to exactly 0, unlike pressure_risk_proxy) to [0, 0.10] for every VALID candidate by the SAME verifier safety gate: SERVICE_BELOW_MINIMUM fires (REJECTED) whenever service_availability < minimum_service_availability (0.90 default, src/hydroswarm/simulation/wrapper.py:444). Empirically near-zero in this population (see identifiability artifact) because the generated candidates on this network/scenario population rarely cause even mild service disruption, not because it is mathematically forced to exactly 0 -- a candidate/population characteristic, not a verifier-gate mathematical necessity.

containment_time_proxy.definition: (240.0 if containment_time_minutes is None else containment_time_minutes) / 240.0
containment_time_proxy.physical_quantity: minutes until contamination is no longer detected above threshold anywhere
containment_time_proxy.raw_units: minutes / 240.0 (dimensionless, 1.0 = 240 minutes OR never contained in-window)
containment_time_proxy.clipping: none (can exceed 1.0 if containment takes > 240 min)
containment_time_proxy.transform: None -> worst-case (1.0) substitution, an explicit design choice (not an accidental default)

plan_regret_proxy.definition: max(0.0, cost - best_cost) where cost = exposure_proxy + pressure_risk_proxy + service_loss_proxy + containment_time_proxy, best_cost = min(cost) over every exactly-verified valid candidate for this SAME incident (including no-response)
plan_regret_proxy.physical_quantity: additive cost gap to the best available verified plan in this incident's own candidate pool
plan_regret_proxy.raw_units: same dimensionless cost scale as the 4 components summed
plan_regret_proxy.normalization: per-incident (best_cost is a per-incident pool minimum)
plan_regret_proxy.clipping: clamped at 0.0 from below only (never negative)
plan_regret_proxy.masking: masked wherever plan_value itself is masked (same is_valid/consequences/no_response/pool gate)
plan_regret_proxy.reference_baseline_plan: the pool minimum-cost candidate for this incident (may or may not be no-response)
plan_regret_proxy.relationship_to_ranking: == regret, the quantity plan_value is a monotone transform of
plan_regret_proxy.per_plan_or_per_incident: per-plan value, but references a per-incident pool minimum

plan_value.clipping: none needed -- 1/(1+regret) is bounded in (0,1] for any regret>=0
plan_value.relationship_to_ranking: THE ranking target (pairwise-ranking gate criterion is computed on this key)
plan_value.REDUNDANCY_FINDING: plan_value and plan_regret_proxy are EXACT, DETERMINISTIC, BIJECTIVE (monotone decreasing) functions of one another by construction: plan_value = 1/(1+regret), plan_regret_proxy = regret, computed from the SAME `regret` local variable in the SAME evaluate_plan_value() call (plan_value_policy.py:127/136/145). They are never independently informative -- a model that learns one exactly determines the other. Empirically verified below (target-correlation artifact): Spearman correlation between the two should equal exactly -1.0 up to floating-point roundoff.

synthetic_monotonicity_check.description: Controlled synthetic pool: A (clearly best) > B (intermediate) > C (clearly worst) > no_response, verified end to end through the real evaluate_plan_value() implementation.
